records.title: Weekly GTD Review Checklist
records.content_summary: Comprehensive checklist for weekly review: collect loose papers, process inbox, review project lists, review waiting-for, review maybe/someday, review calendar, review goals.

records.title: Home Blood Pressure Monitoring Protocol
records.content_summary: Measure at same time daily, sit quietly 5 min before, arm at heart level, take two readings 1 min apart, record in health app.

records.title: 50/30/20 Budget Allocation Reference
records.content_summary: Needs 50%, Wants 30%, Savings/Debt 20%. Review quarterly. Adjust for seasonal variations per banking data.

records.title: Sourdough Starter Maintenance Schedule
records.content_summary: Feed 1:1:1 ratio daily if room temp, weekly if refrigerated. Discard half before feeding. Look for doubling within 4-6 hours.

records.title: Common Software Architecture Patterns
records.content_summary: Reference for Microservices vs Monolith, Event-Driven, CQRS, Domain-Driven Design principles with trade-offs.

records.title: Professional Relationship Maintenance System
records.content_summary: Touch base quarterly with close contacts, annually with acquaintances. Use context from meetings drawn from calendar history.
